name: Balanced Product
description: A neutral first presentation of a selected CAD subject.
scope: A saved authoring composition with explicit demo objects/quality bounds. Source role and capability requirements remain in the recipe; it is not a promise of every original simulation feature.
preview_scope: Actual SolidCraft GPU image; 64 samples, denoised. Read the receipt/variant; this is not a convergence or full-physics claim.
limitations: Demo objects are placeholders for explicit user roles; no user selection is guessed.
Native looks are the uniform projection, not an assertion that custom texture maps persisted.
Native fixed sampling does not assert the original convergence/error estimator.
Quality specification is a target, not a measured guarantee for every scene.
